data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Friday, October 2, 2026: Crypto prices surging ahead of September jobs report
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $84,849.93 on Friday, October 2, 2026, up 1.6% from Thursday's open. As of 7:25 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin jumped to $86,459.67. Ethereum opened at $2,705.58 today, up 0.8% from Thursday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved up to $2,747.05 as of 7:25 a.m. ET.
